name: Eternal Hunt adds 10% maximum health and cuts resource costs by 10% (#3362)
contract: Eternal Hunt 804201 ships two SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA effects in Spell.dbc: aura 133 SPELL_AURA_MOD_INCREASE_HEALTH_PERCENT with BasePoints 9 + DieSides 1 = 10% (AuraEffect::HandleAuraModIncreaseHealthPercent) and aura 72 SPELL_AURA_MOD_POWER_COST_SCHOOL_PCT with BasePoints -11 + DieSides 1 = -10%, MiscValue 127 (all schools), consumed by SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost through AuraEffect::HandleModPowerCostPCT. 804201 is the only Eternal Hunt record in Spell.dbc. Bloodbolt 578305 is the probe for the cost half: it is the rank a level-80 character owns, its PowerType is 1 and its shipped cost is 300, and its SchoolMask 32 is inside the aura's 127. The bindmysoul snapshot says 5% on both effects while the shipped Spell.dbc says 10%; the installed DBC wins, so 10% is what is asserted here.

steps.label: Bloodbolt costs its shipped 300 before the talent
